newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash crudes slide on further paper sell-off.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash crudes slide on further paper sell-off.

text.p: Outright crude values slid further Monday afternoon, leaving U.S. cash crudes weaker on the technical sell-off in paper markets.
Traders said cash markets have seen only a few confirmed trades, with prices for grade differentials steady to firmer in the sweet markets and mostly steady for the sours.
March West Texas Intermediate/Cushing was around 25 cents lower at $21.90-95 a barrel, with the March/April WTI roll hovering around the 23-25 cts mark.
Trades recorded were for March Postings Plus, which was sold slightly weaker at WTI/Cushing +$1.99/2.00.
